info.cls_ename: Department of Aerospace and Systems Engineering

description.describe_ch: 材料力學(一)主要在講解物體受力產生變形之行為，以啟發學生解決材料與結構的相關力學問題的能力。。內容包括應力、應變、材料力學性質、桿件之拉伸與壓縮、及桿件扭轉。
description.describe_eh: The objective is to make students soundly understand the behavior of solid bodies subjected to various types of loading. Contents include  stresses、 strains、mechanical properties of materials、 axially loaded members、 and  torsion.

targets.describe_ch: 使學生對工程中之材料性質與應力形式有相當之瞭解。
targets.describe_en: To acquire an understanding of the properties of materials and types of stresses

targets.describe_ch: 使學生能應用力平衡公式、判斷結構支撐條件與求解反作用力。
targets.describe_en: To gain the ability to apply force equilibrium, identify structure supports and solve reactive forces

targets.describe_ch: 培養學生對外力、支撐與產生應力之關係有分析與求解之能力
targets.describe_en: To develop the ability of analyzing and solving the relations among loads, supports, and induced stresses

targets.describe_ch: 培養學生對結構及材料力學相關專業英語之認識
targets.describe_en: To gain the ability of recognizing the structural and material English terminology
